name: get_weather
description: 查询指定城市的天气信息。当有人问天气时使用。

city.description: 城市名称，如：北京、上海、广州

scriptContent:
function run(args, ctx)
    if type(args.city) ~= "string" or not args.city:find("%S") then return "错误：请提供城市名" end
    local city = args.city:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    local encoded = url.encode(city):gsub("+", "%%20")
    local response = http.request({url = "https://wttr.in/" .. encoded .. "?format=j1", timeout_ms = 30000})
    if not response.ok then return "天气请求失败：" .. response.error end
    if response.status ~= 200 then return "天气接口 HTTP " .. response.status .. "：" .. response.body end
    local ok, result = pcall(json.decode, response.body)
    if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.current_condition) ~= "table"
        or not result.current_condition[1] then return "天气接口响应格式无效" end
    local current = result.current_condition[1]
    return city .. "当前天气：\n温度：" .. tostring(current.temp_C)
        .. "°C\n体感：" .. tostring(current.FeelsLikeC) .. "°C\n湿度："
        .. tostring(current.humidity) .. "%\n风速：" .. tostring(current.windspeedKmph) .. " km/h"
end
readme:
# get_weather

Lua 自定义工具，不依赖 Python。通过异步 HTTP 请求访问 wttr.in，返回当前温度、体感、湿度和风速。
